clauses.clause: When this creature enters, destroy target nonland permanent an opponent controls.
clauses.evidence: [cast] variants: ask target: [opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant, opp_relic, opp_charm] (no land, nothing of yours); each chosen target is targeted and moves battlefield -> graveyard (by card/DESTROY), dies; also on the entry during the opponent's turn.
